payload.build_machine: Ten chunks, dependency-edged, realization: engine-ts unless noted (the drawn chunk sub-machine rides this evidence until the seeding executor - chunk C2 - exists to run one). C1 hot-reload [no deps, FIRST on purpose]: mtime-keyed dynamic engine import in the se-mcp shim - kills the owner reconnect chore for every later chunk; fallback shim-restart via C7. C2 token engine [after C1]: active[] + fired[] on the instance, activeStates/completeState/claim ops in machine.ts + new instance.ts with the lock+atomic write lane (greens executor.test.ts incl. the 2x100 concurrency law); two-agent serving stays flagged off until green. C3 run service [after C1]: startRun/runStatus handles + runs store; next()/submit() route engine-filled states through it (greens the 1s law tests; kills the 5s submits). C4 law guards [after C1, parallel to C2/C3]: commit window open-at-bless/close-at-submit wired into se_git; toll requires update on submit; boot requires named project; test-lane scope refusal (greens laws.test.ts). C5 offer queue [after C2]: state-keyed offers, dismiss/supersede/replace ops + red tests with it. C6 log hygiene + generic aggregation [independent]: clause+reason on failures, one line per dispatch, filter/group/count query lane + red tests. C7 process lane [independent]: owned-process list/stop/cycle. C8 lanes pack [independent]: apply ergonomics (execute-by-hash, optional dry_run, surgical canvas ops), declared search roots, plan insert/renumber ops, link-graph rename ripple + red tests each. C9 retro mechanics [after C6]: drained-marking, last_verify by timestamp, lean strike-list, inherit-evidence acceptance, registry-rendered contract lanes + red tests. C10 board pass [after C2]: side-by-side branches, token highlights, maximize fills screen, scroll preserved on refresh (the owner's two bugs ride here per their note). Every chunk = one commit-sized unit behind its gate-blessed windows; interruption loses at most one chunk.
